description:
Get everything recorded about one screen: notes on what it does and how it's laid out, product,
captured date, page url, source URL, dimensions, observed actions and where they lead, and page
sections for long marketing pages. The notes are not the screen: call get_screen_image with the
same id to see it before building something similar.

screenId.description: Screen id from search_screens or get_product, e.g. linear-signup.

name: get_screen
title: Get one screen
